title: 第17章 关于狐狸的历史故事第18章 主大陆
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可终于抵达了村子的入口。一开始，守卫们个个如临大敌，对她充满了戒备，然而，当她亮出巴迪的物件时，他们这才匆忙把巴迪给召唤了过来。
“你可让咱好等。”巴迪哼了一声，目光瞅见这只“气鼓鼓”的狐狸正急得直跺脚。“我早给你把那份准备好了，你想留下啥都行，或者跟咱换点别的玩意儿。”
他笑着跟她说道，他们这回的收获那可真是丰硕得惊人，瞧着那些人类为了寻找什么东西耗费了大把的资源，可最终似乎啥也没找着。到头来，占便宜的就属他们和这只小狐狸了。
“进来吧，虽说不能留你长期居住，打着庆祝的幌子倒是没什么问题！”他冲着她乐呵呵地说道。“我回头再回答你的问题，这会儿，咱先走着。”
艾可瞬间就蹦到了他的背上，而他倒也丝毫不介意。就因为这只古灵精怪的小调皮鬼，他才能毫发无损。穿过村子，只见一栋栋更多的木屋错落有致地林立着。
这村子似乎因为近来的战斗而变得富得流油。虽说弥漫着那么一点儿忧郁的气氛，可大多数人都在大口吃肉，喝着一种带着红沫的黄色液体，尽情地欢庆着。
“你可不能喝！”巴迪大声说道。“在你确定好要什么奖赏之前，咱得保证你状态良好！不然，我会觉得自己坑了你。”巴迪乐呵地哼了一声。他倒还真不会坑她，不过趁着她清醒做交易显然更好，免得她日后觉得自己受骗。要是她有这样的想法，他心里可得难受得要命。
艾可赶忙点点头，她向来对酒都没有什么兴趣，错过这场庆祝她倒是不怎么心疼，可要是错过肉那可万万不行。
“哟！是这小狐狸。”黑豹不知从哪个角落里冒了出来，脸蛋微红。“今儿跟咱们一块儿喝酒不？”别说是脸蛋微红了，他整个人都醉得一塌糊涂，瞧他对着一块石头滔滔不绝地说话就知道了。
艾可轻轻地摇了摇自己的小脑袋，引得旁边几个路过的人都冲着她笑了笑。
巴迪接着大步往前走，压根就不理会那个对着一根杆子喋喋不休的战友。
他把艾可恭恭敬敬地请到了自己家里。那门大得出奇，兴许是因为巴迪身材魁梧，不过屋子建造得倒是挺简单的。要是有人瞧见这木屋，多半会说这是个谷仓而非房子。
艾可心里也是这么想的，不过好在她不会说话，倒是省去了不少麻烦。巴迪在这村里简直被众人奉为神明，她要是胆敢乱说话，准得挨不少数落。
这屋子内部简单得很。里头的家具更像是人的而非马的。压根不见一点儿干草的影子，倒是有大大的沙发或者叫做“椅子”的东西。跟这宽敞的大房子一比，艾可显得小得可怜，让她不禁感觉有点儿压抑。
巴迪不慌不忙地穿过屋子，走进了里头的一间房间。只见桌上摆放着几个戒指，还有写满了字的羊皮纸。
可惜艾可不识字，只能眼巴巴地等着巴迪给她念，不过她在心里暗自下定决心，回头一定要给自己买个语言技能。
……
巴迪跟她讲述了纸上的内容，她就那么呆呆地盯着他。大多数的东西她都不晓得，像他说的什么“燃烧之剑”，或者“悲伤之盾”，她还能勉强猜猜，可剩下的那些？想都别想！那些……名字实在是太别扭了，她压根没法从这些稀奇古怪的名字里想出什么有意义的东西。
“我把每个东西都拿出来，你直接跟我说你要不要。”巴迪这样帮助她，毕竟要是他自己在那场战斗里单打独斗，受伤肯定会更加严重。
艾可连忙点点头，他往外拿东西的时候她就乖乖地在一旁听着。

大多数东西她都不喜欢，她短时间内既不会用剑，也不会用盾。至于那些草药……路边不就能轻易找到吗？
“你得把那些草药拿着！”巴迪向她施压道，他还从来没见过这么机灵却又如此无知的狐狸。“那些对于你的修炼进阶那可是必不可少的！”他一脸严肃地跟她说道。
艾可无奈地点点头，同意留下那些草药。
“不行！这些灵石你绝对不能不要！这就好比拒绝金子一样！对于修炼者来说它们可是无价之宝！”
“不行！你得——”
……
这事儿折腾了大半夜。巴迪那股执着的劲头把艾可给彻底弄晕了，她感到心力交瘁。要是想顺顺利利地进阶，她就得想方设法提升自己的属性，不然没准儿就会变成一个糊涂蛋……
艾可无奈地叹着气，手里拿着5个她根本用不了的[储物戒指]。剩下的都换成了灵石……可她同样也用不了。这……真是让人失望到了极点。
她的耳朵耷拉着，就像被人狠狠地骗了一把似的，巴迪见状忍不住笑了起来。
“过会儿有一场盛大的盛宴，你就耐心等着，这会儿，咱先坐下，我跟你讲讲历史，还有为什么大多数甚至所有村子都不愿意收留你。”巴迪轻声安慰着这只小狐狸。
艾可点点头，可她的耳朵还是没有恢复精神，毕竟食物离她还远着呢。
巴迪带着她来到了热闹非凡的地方，和艾可一起坐下开始讲故事。
content_en:
Echo finally arrived at the entrance of the village. At first, the guards were all on guard against her. However, when she showed Buddy's belongings, they hurriedly summoned Buddy.
"You can make us wait." Buddy snorted and saw the "angry" fox stamping his feet anxiously. "I've already prepared that for you. You can keep whatever you want, or trade it with us for something else."
He smiled and told her that their harvest this time was really amazing. It looked like those humans spent a lot of resources looking for something, but in the end they seemed to find nothing. In the end, it was them and the little fox who took advantage.
"Come in, although I can't keep you here for a long time, there's nothing wrong with using it as a celebration!" He said cheerfully to her. "I'll answer your question later. For now, let's walk."
Aike jumped on his back in an instant, but he didn't mind at all. It was only because of this quirky little naughty guy that he was able to escape unscathed. Passing through the village, I saw more wooden houses standing in an orderly manner.
The village seems to have become extremely wealthy as a result of the recent fighting. Although there was a bit of melancholy atmosphere, most people were eating meat, drinking a yellow liquid with red foam, and celebrating to their heart's content.
"You can't drink!" Buddy shouted. "Before you decide what reward you want, I have to make sure you are in good condition! Otherwise, I will feel like I cheated you." Buddy snorted happily. He really wouldn't cheat her, but it was obviously better to make the deal while she was awake, lest she feel cheated in the future. It would make him terribly uncomfortable if she had such thoughts.
Ai Ke nodded quickly. She had never been interested in wine. She didn't feel bad about missing this celebration, but it was definitely not okay if she missed the meat.
"Yo! It's this little fox." The black panther appeared out of nowhere, his face slightly red. "Would you like to have a drink with us today?" Not to mention his slightly red face, he was completely drunk, just look at him talking non-stop to a stone.
Aiko shook her little head gently, causing several people passing by to smile at her.
Buddy then strode forward, paying no attention to his comrade who was chattering to a pole.
He respectfully invited Aike to his home. The door was surprisingly large, perhaps because of Buddy's huge stature, but the house was built quite simply. If anyone had seen the cabin, they would probably have said it was a barn rather than a house.
Aike thought the same thing in her heart, but fortunately she couldn't speak, which saved her a lot of trouble. Buddy is regarded as a god by everyone in this village. If she dares to talk nonsense, she will be scolded a lot.
The interior of this house is very simple. The furniture inside looked more human than equine. There was no sign of hay at all, but there was a big sofa or something called a "chair". Compared with this spacious house, Ai Ke looked pitifully small, which made her feel a little depressed.
Buddy walked leisurely through the house and into an inner room. I saw a few rings on the table, as well as parchment filled with writing.
Unfortunately, Aike was illiterate and could only wait helplessly for Buddy to read it to her. However, she secretly made up her mind to buy herself a language skill later.
…
Buddy told her what was on the paper, and she just stared at him blankly. She didn't know most of the things. Like the "Burning Sword" or the "Shield of Sorrow" he mentioned, she could barely guess, but the rest? Don’t even think about it! Those... names were so awkward that she couldn't think of anything meaningful from these weird names."I'll take everything out, and you just tell me if you want it." Buddy helped her like this. After all, if he had fought alone in that battle, his injuries would definitely be more serious.
Ai Ke nodded quickly, and she listened obediently while he took things out.
She doesn't like most things, and she can neither use a sword nor a shield anytime soon. As for those herbs...can't they be easily found on the roadside?
"You have to hold those herbs!" Buddy pressed her. He had never seen such a clever but ignorant fox. "Those are indispensable for your cultivation and advancement!" He said to her seriously.
Aike nodded helplessly and agreed to keep the herbs.
"No! You absolutely cannot refuse these spiritual stones! This is like rejecting gold! They are priceless treasures for cultivators!"
"No! You have to-"
…
This matter took up most of the night. Buddy's persistence made Echo completely dizzy, and she felt exhausted mentally and physically. If she wanted to advance smoothly, she had to find ways to improve her attributes, otherwise she might become a fool...
Ai Ke sighed helplessly, holding 5 [storage rings] in her hand that she couldn't use at all. The rest were replaced with spirit stones...but she couldn't use them either. This... is extremely disappointing.
Her ears were drooped, as if she had been severely tricked, and Buddy couldn't help laughing when he saw this.
"There will be a grand feast later. Just wait patiently. Now, let's sit down and I'll tell you about history and why most or even all villages are unwilling to take you in." Buddy comforted the little fox softly.
Aike nodded, but her ears still didn't recover. After all, the food was still far away from her.
Buddy took her to a busy place, sat down with Echo and started telling stories.
